_doc: Garment slots for body-conditioned view generation (tools/Render-BodyDepthViews.py). z is a fraction of the body height (feet 0, head top 1) bounding the slot's region (a hard cut at the lower edge); margin scales the square view frame around that region (1.0 = the region's height fills it). A null z is a slot still to fill. Optional arm_cut_z (fraction of height) drops arm-weighted vertices below it, but leaves holes in the torso's side in side views. grow_px / smooth_px: dilate the silhouette (cloth thickness) and blur the depth so skin detail (ears, lips) does not reach the garment.
